item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: no strong 2024 evidence surfaced of de-escalatory nuclear rhetoric such as renewed arms-control commitment, de-alerting, or a clear public commitment to narrow nuclear thresholds.","evidence":[{"title":"Answers by Vladimir Putin and Alexander Lukashenko to media questions","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74002","summary":"Putin said a tactical nuclear-weapons drill was “not about using these weapons,” adding that it was “just routine work.” This is the clearest restraint-flavored line I found in 2024, but it came inside the context of a live tactical nuclear exercise in Belarus, so it only weakly supports responsible rhetoric.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"Russia says it will change nuclear doctrine because of Western role in Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-09-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-will-change-nuclear-doctrine-due-to-wests-actions-in-ukraine-official-says-3596699","summary":"Reuters reported that Moscow’s nuclear-doctrine revision was justified as a response to Western involvement in Ukraine. That is classic brinkmanship framing: nuclear policy used as coercive signaling tied to war leverage rather than restraint.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"Executive Order Approving the Basic Principles of State Policy of the Russian Federation on Nuclear Deterrence","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-11-19","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/news/75598","summary":"Putin signed a new deterrence doctrine replacing the 2020 version. The official text formalizes conditions for nuclear use and centers deterrence threats, which normalizes nuclear signaling and broadens escalation space rather than using the topic sparingly.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"Putin's comments at the meeting on nuclear deterrence principles","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/75887","summary":"Putin said Russia had “specified” the principles for using nuclear weapons, kept non-strategic nuclear forces on constant alert, and continued exercises, while linking this posture to U.S. missile deployments.
